name: Hive 1.6.0
notes: A broad UX polish pass. Code blocks are now syntax-highlighted with a language header; each agent turn is attributed to the model that actually produced it (switching runtimes no longer relabels history). The command palette gained real navigation and actions — jump to any pane, settings tab, or view, toggle light/dark — not just chat switching. @file opens a fuzzy workspace-file picker instead of asking you to type a path from memory. The Review pane shows a pending badge and renders proposal diffs per file like a pull request. Settings search matches content ("api key", "relay", "reset"), the workspace root gets a native folder picker, and turning on "bypass all permissions" now asks first. Onboarding warns when the chosen agent CLI isn't installed, with a re-check. Plus: keyboard-reachable message actions, a workspace crumb when the sidebar is collapsed, capped toasts, and a clearer update banner.
